workload.summary: Produce source-linked review suggestions from a repository change; human owns external publication and merge.

framework.rationale: Constructed example: conditional checks and restart evidence are the hypotheses to test; selection is not a comparative result.
criteria: branch only into checks relevant to the diff
recover after process interruption without repeating writes
keep external comment and merge authority human-owned

releaseCriteria: zero unauthorized or duplicate effects in the tested set
all task-level failures are reviewed before scope expansion

security.rationale: Repository content and tool credentials require explicit boundary review even in this constructed pilot.
threats: sensitive source or comments entering provider traces
controls: treat repository text as untrusted data
document provider data and trace retention before use

incidentResponse.rationale: A pilot that can call tools needs a named pause and recovery route.
recovery: record unresolved state and route to operator

cost.rationale: Constructed sample assumes provider and runtime charges.
cost.estimateMethod: provider usage receipts plus measured runtime/tool charges; sum all attempts and allocate fixed costs separately
cost.abortAction: stop admitting tasks when the local cap or deadline is reached; preserve partial-state and reconcile effect before retry
cost.pricingEvidence: record provider/model rate source and date before running

observability.rationale: Need to relate task outcomes to tool events and costs.
observability.retention: choose locally after data-class review; this sample is not a retention policy

effects.authority: service account limited to selected repository

effects.rationale: never merge or publish automatically in this constructed pilot

effectPolicy.defaultRule: deny any effect not explicitly declared; model suggestions alone do not authorize effects

adoption.pilotScope: one repository and one pre-review workflow; constructed scope only
adoption.communicationPlan: show task scope, data handling, known limits, human control, pause path, and unresolved evidence
adoption.baselineMethod: compare the same versioned task set and rubric against the current human-plus-static-check process
expansionGates: account for total and support cost
collect user feedback and opt-out reasons
adoption.retirementPlan: revoke tool scope, stop admission, retain only records required by a locally reviewed retention policy

mcp.rationale: MCP is not required by this constructed workload; a protocol is not a framework choice.

memory.rationale: No user-memory requirement is assumed; retain task evidence separately only under a defined policy.

performance.rationale: Set an end-to-end latency objective locally from reviewer workflow evidence before measurement.
performance.throughputObjective: measure only if workload volume requires it

returnModel.rationale: Compare full attributable cost with matched accepted-task output before making any return claim.
baselineMetrics: human review minutes per rubric-passing task
excludedCosts: none yet; document any exclusion before reporting
